# Student Consulting MOU

# Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)

This Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) establishes a collaborative partnership between:

Faculty Name: __John Drake, PhD_________

Student Name: Kyle Robertson, Ehsanullah Pardisi, Bara Abusamhan, Leonard Mann

Small Business Client Name: Quick Phone

Semester/Term: __Fall 2026_________

Date: 09/08/2026

## 1. Purpose

The purpose of this MOU is to outline the roles, responsibilities, and expectations of faculty, students, and the small business client in a student consulting project facilitated through the MIS capstone course, MIS 4173. This collaboration aims to provide students with experiential learning opportunities while analyzing a business problem, designing a solution, building that solution, and implementing it within the client's technology infrastructure. 

2. Project Scope

The scope of the project includes:
- Project Title: ___Quick Phone Repair Management System_____
- Brief Description: A web-based system intake and schedule repair jobs, track job status from check-in through customer pickup, and manage parts inventory levels. The system will give staff a single view of open repairs and parts availability.
- Expected Deliverables: Working prototype system, interface designs, a technical specification document, and a training session with a written user manual.
- Timeline: From _September 2026___ to _December 2026__________

## 3. Roles & Responsibilities

Faculty will:

- Meet with the client to ensure objectives and/or deliverables are clear and timeframes are set.

- Provide guidance and supervision to students.

- Ensure project aligns with course objectives.

- Act as the primary point of contact for academic issues.

Students will:

- Conduct professional and ethical consulting work.

- Meet agreed-upon deadlines and deliverables.

- Maintain confidentiality regarding client information.

- Provide the finished deliverables to the client at the end of the semester.

Small Business Client will:

- Provide access to the necessary business information.

- Communicate in a timely manner with students and faculty.

- Offer feedback and insights as needed.

## 4. Communication Preferences

Preferred Communication Method (Email/Phone/Other): ___pardisi1987@gmail.com__
Frequency of Meetings: One kickoff meeting (approximately 60 min), followed by approximately 30 minutes at the close of each sprint (six sessions).
Primary Contact Person: ___Ashiqullah Pardisi_____________

## 5. Timeline & Deliverables

The following timeline and deliverables are agreed upon:
Key Milestones:

- Sprint 1: problem definition and feasibility (Sept 14-20)

- Sprint 2: requirements and analysis (Oct 5-11)

- Sprint 3: interface design (Oct 19-25)

- Sprint 4: working system demonstration (Nov 2-8)

- Sprint 5: training session (Nov 16-22)

- Sprint 6: final presentation and handoff (Nov 30-Dec 9).

- Final Deliverables Due: December 9, 2026

## 6. Confidentiality Agreement

Students and faculty recognize the importance of protecting confidential business information. If required, a formal Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) can be provided through ECU University Counsel. The small business client should inform the faculty member if an NDA is necessary for the scope of work.

## 7. Conflict Resolution

Any disputes or misunderstandings should be brought to the attention of the faculty supervisor for resolution.
